cues: Cool a normal metal, and its resistance falls, because the lattice ions vibrate less and scatter the electrons less.
Impurities and defects leave a residual resistivity, even at absolute zero.
text: Cool a normal metal, and its resistance falls, because the lattice ions vibrate less and scatter the electrons less. But it never reaches zero. Impurities and defects leave a residual resistivity, even at absolute zero.
